label: FS AP-T567 (Wi-Fi 6 outdoor AP, copper + fibre)
description: FS AP-T567 - Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) IP68 outdoor AP, 2x2 dual-radio up to 2.4 Gbps, built-in directional antennas. 1x 1G RJ45 with 802.3af/at PoE-in (12.95 W max), 1x 1G SFP, 1x RJ45 console.
notes: Vendor figures from the FS AP-T567 datasheet: **1 x 10/100/1000Base-T Ethernet with PoE input, 1 x GE SFP, 1 x RJ45 console**, **802.3af powered, 12.95 W max**, IP68. The datasheet's headline "up to 2G wired access rate" is the **sum of the two ports** - each is 1G, and the SFP is 1G only, not 2.5G. Directional antennas and multi-hop PtMP bridging are in the box; the PoE injector is not.
